newsitem.title: USA: Miami Computer co-founder has 5.7 pct stake.
newsitem.headline: Miami Computer co-founder has 5.7 pct stake.

text.p: Miami Computer Supply Corp. co-founder Thomas Winstel said he has acquired 194,060 common shares of his company, or 5.73 percent of the total outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Winstel said he acquired the stake in private transactions for investment purposes.
Winstel, who is also a director and vice president of the company, said his stake includes 18,060 shares that he acquired in the company's initial public offering on Nov. 12.
